system: Modbus RTU server (slave) library, C11 and Rust (no_std) twins

author.source_of_these_fields: Vibe's own export.json per round (vibe_version, config.active_model, config.models.*.name, limits, steps, cost_usd, outcome)

boundary.workdir: a fresh directory per twin on the bench machine's data volume, not a git repository, no remote
boundary.environment: env -i with: HOME and VIBE_HOME (a scratch home and a separate Vibe config: auto-update off, no other projects' sessions), PATH (cargo, cppcheck, /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin; no gh), RUSTUP_HOME, CARGO_HOME, KANI_HOME, RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0, TMPDIR, CARGO_TARGET_DIR, BUILD_DIR, FXM_BUILD_DIR (all build output on the internal disk), TERM, LANG, MISTRAL_API_KEY
boundary.credentials: Vibe's own MISTRAL_API_KEY was in its environment: Vibe reads it from the macOS keychain, which an ssh session cannot unlock, so a gui-domain launchd job read it and handed it over through a FIFO (never written to disk). No other credential: no GITHUB_TOKEN, no CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, no gh, no git push
boundary.smoke_test: a probe round listed its environment variable names; none but MISTRAL_API_KEY is a credential

round_definition: one round = one headless Vibe invocation; rounds 2+ are new invocations in the same directory with a prompt listing the defects an independent mechanical check found

rounds.ended: stopped by itself, NOTES.md said PARTIAL
rounds.mechanical_state_after: make test crashed (bus error), 37 warnings, hidden suites did not compile, 321 MISRA findings, 1780 lines

builds and passes; 2 warnings; 196 MISRA on the baseline; the 0x17 code added 21 findings; the generator's fc17 group had 1 normal 0x17 response (malformed requests), so no case tested write-before-read

rounds.ended: stopped by itself after fixing the warnings, estimating 8-15 hours of remaining work and asking a question
rounds.mechanical_state_after: warnings fixed; vectors and findings unchanged

rounds.ended: its done gate (done.sh) exits 0; re-run by us after the round
rounds.beyond_guidance: a fourth round, beyond the ~3 rounds of guidance: rounds 1 and 3 ended by the model stopping on its own, not on a capability limit, so round 4 changed the prompt's shape (one executable done gate, no human, scope cut to the two items that blocked checks) rather than its wording

rounds.mechanical_state_after: Kani harnesses weak: CRC only, no frame or 0x17 harness

rounds.ended: stopped by itself; NOTES.md claimed every check passed, the gate failed 2 (the library used alloc/Vec, which Kani 0.67 cannot verify here; the 0x17 harness sent no request)
HTTP 402 from Mistral: Vibe budget exhausted
rounds.mechanical_state_after: allocation-free; every gate item passes except Kani: the 0x17 harness (unwind 450) does not finish in 900 s

cost_source: sum of cost_usd from Vibe's export.json per round, at Vibe's configured model prices; not Mistral's bill
known_oracle_gaps: n_fc17_read_qty_125 sends write quantity 0, so it tests exception 0x03; the fc17 suite has no normal response at read quantity 125
boundary_events: C rounds 1-3: Vibe rewrote the given strip_fc17.py although told not to (its hash before round 4 was 36f2a81f...). The acceptance checks never use it: check_task.py strips with its own implementation. From round 4 (C) and round 1 (Rust) every given file was hash-checked before and after each round and was unchanged.
Vibe's own reports were wrong twice (Rust round 2's NOTES.md said every check passed; C round 1 said the code was complete in parts it was not). Acceptance used only the mechanical checks.
post_authoring_edits_by_the_task_builder: C Makefile: the hand-listed SRC_FILES became $(wildcard src/*.c), so a new source file builds without a Makefile edit, which the agent is not allowed to make. Without it the baseline (which has no src/mb_func_fc17.c) did not build.

Vector generator: a split-hygiene filter, so the hidden groups share no whole case with the visible group and 0x10 at quantity 122 and 123 is hidden-only (the authoring spec asked for both; the generator broke them). It removed 1 visible and 4 regression cases (visible 29, regression 42, fc17 22).
Vector generator, Rust writer: the &'static fix was made by Vibe in Rust round 1; the C and Rust twins share that one generator, which regenerates the C twin's vector files byte-identically.
Split rule: a source file with nothing but includes or imports outside its feature markers is new in the reference and absent from the baseline (src/mb_func_fc17.c).

noise_budget_history.c: cppcheck MISRA findings on the baseline: 20..50 set before authoring; 30..150 before round 3; 150..250 before round 4 (final). Moved because rounds 1-3 could not bring the count down, and the doc fixes the budget only before calibration. Final: 196.
noise_budget_history.rust: clippy all+pedantic warnings on the baseline: 20..150, set before Rust authoring and not moved. Final: 139.
